stem:
Lalit sits behind a wall and uses a Z-shaped periscope with two plane mirrors to see the stage. He wonders whether reflection or refraction carries the light.

How does he see the stage?

options.text: Light from the stage reflects from the first mirror and then from the second mirror to his eye.
Light from the stage is refracted by both mirrors to his eye.
One plane mirror is enough for this Z-shaped periscope.
His eye sends light through the two mirrors to the stage.

teacher.key_rationale: A Z-periscope needs two reflections so light from the stage reaches the eye. Refraction swaps the wrong process. One mirror omits the second reflection. Eye-to-stage reverses the light path.
